derivation: from H1431 (גָּדַל) (in the sense of twisting);
def: thread, i.e. a tassel or festoon

occurrences.text: Thou shalt make thee fringes upon the four quarters of thy vesture, wherewith thou coverest thyself.
And nets of checker work, and wreaths of chain work, for the chapiters which were upon the top of the pillars; seven for the one chapiter, and seven for the other chapiter.
